# iximiuz-labs_plays (Data Source)

Lists all iximiuz Labs play sessions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iximiuz-labs_plays" "all" {}

output "running_plays" {
  value = [for p in data.iximiuz-labs_plays.all.plays : p.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plays` (Attributes List) The list of play sessions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plays))

<a id="nestedatt--plays"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plays`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the play session.
- `page_url` (String) Web UI URL for the play.
- `status` (String) Current state of the play.
